title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional study nooks, quiet reading rooms, and collaborative lounges that Chapman students use to escape the main campus crowds.

cards.title: Fashionables Terrace
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries 4th Floor
cards.notes: Head to the 4th floor and turn left from the elevators to find this outdoor patio. It offers round tables with umbrellas and views of Wilson Field and the mountains.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor 4th-floor library terrace with tables and umbrellas for studying with a view.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fashionables Terrace is located on the 4th floor of the Leatherby Libraries and features outdoor tables and comfortable seating for study.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 8 AM to 5 PM, weather permitting.

cards.title: Argyros Forum Roof Patio
cards.subtitle: Argyros Forum Top Floor
cards.notes: Take the stairs to the top floor of Argyros Forum to access this quiet outdoor area. It features benches and tables away from the main student union noise.
cards.short_summary: A quiet rooftop patio on the top floor of the student union building.
cards.evidence_claim: The roof patio of Argyros Forum is a quiet and private study spot with plenty of tables and benches.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus - The Voice of Wilkinson

cards.title: Keck Center Hallways
cards.subtitle: Keck Center for Science and Engineering
cards.notes: Use the erasable walls in the hallways to map out complex problems. These open collaborative spaces are designed for spontaneous group work between classes.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative hallway spaces featuring floor-to-ceiling erasable whiteboard walls.
cards.evidence_claim: The hallways in the Keck Center for Science and Engineering are designed with walls you can write on to foster collaboration.

cards.title: Mezzanine Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: Sandi Simon Center for Dance
cards.notes: Located on the third-level mezzanine of the repurposed packing house, this intimate room is ideal for solo studying or small group collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study room located on the third-level mezzanine of the Dance Center.
cards.evidence_claim: A quiet room at the third-level mezzanine of the Sandi Simon Center for Dance offers an intimate space for studying alone or collaborating.
cards.source_title: Chapman University - Sandi Simon Center for Dance - SCUP
cards.access_notes: Located within the Sandi Simon Center for Dance.

cards.title: Huell Howser Archive Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries Lower Level
cards.notes: Find this quiet room on the lower level near the California's Gold exhibit. It offers a silent environment for focused reading and textbook work.
cards.short_summary: A silent reading room located within the Huell Howser Archives on the library's lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: The Huell Howser Archive reading room on the lower level of Leatherby Libraries is a quiet place for students to study.
cards.source_title: Did You Know You Could Study Here? - Leatherby Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM.

cards.title: Beckman Hall 4th Floor
cards.subtitle: Beckman Hall
cards.notes: Sit by the large windows on either side of the fourth floor for natural light. This floor is mostly offices, making it significantly quieter than the lower levels.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, sun-drenched hallway study area on the top floor of Beckman Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth floor of Beckman Hall is quiet with large windows and a patio, making it a preferred study spot.
cards.source_title: The Best Study Spots at Chapman
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically quietest during office hours.

cards.title: Doti Hall Patio
cards.subtitle: Doti Hall East Side
cards.notes: Located on the east side of Doti Hall, this outdoor area has tables with umbrellas. It is a low-traffic alternative to the library's main outdoor seating.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor patio with umbrellas and benches on the east side of Doti Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Doti Hall patio on the east side of the building is a quiet location with plenty of tables and benches.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus - The Voice of Wilkinson

cards.title: Prayer and Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Fish Interfaith Center
cards.notes: Visit this room for a moment of silence or reflection. It is equipped with meditation cushions and prayer rugs and is open to all students regardless of belief.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space for prayer, meditation, or silent reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fish Interfaith Center includes a prayer and meditation room with cushions and rugs, open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 9 PM.
cards.source_title: About Fish Interfaith Center - Chapman University

cards.title: DMAC Laptop Bars
cards.subtitle: Digital Media Arts Center
cards.notes: The DMAC features multiple laptop bars and a student lounge area with recliners. It's a high-tech environment inspired by industry studios like Pixar.
cards.short_summary: Modern laptop bars and lounge areas within the Digital Media Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Media Arts Center includes multiple laptop bars and a student lounge area with couches and recliners.
cards.source_title: Digital Media Arts Center - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for Dodge College students; accessible to others during building hours.

cards.title: Health Sciences Study Commons
cards.subtitle: Rinker Campus, Building 9401
cards.notes: Located on the first floor of Building 9401 at the Rinker Campus, this space offers 12 collaborative rooms and 20 individual study spaces for graduate students.
cards.short_summary: A specialized study commons for health science students at the Irvine campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Sciences Study Commons at the Rinker Campus provides twelve collaborative study rooms and twenty individual study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for Rinker students; requires Chapman ID for room reservations.
